title: Faithful or Silent? Evaluating Retrieval Design and Abstention Behavior in Medical Retrieval-Augmented Generation — code, results, and certified test artifact
description: Code, archived experimental outputs, and the certified unanswerable-question test artifact for the paper "Faithful or Silent? Evaluating Retrieval Design and Abstention Behavior in Medical Retrieval-Augmented Generation". Includes the held-out-context construction on PubMedQA (250 verifiably unanswerable questions, 244 NLI-certified evidence-free traps), the 13-configuration retrieval grid, raw completions for three model families (25,350 completions), statistics, and full provenance. Code is licensed Apache-2.0; the data (artifact/ and results/) is CC BY 4.0.
